emission spectrum is formed.  [3]
(e)  The work was first reported in a peer-reviewed scientific journal.  Outline why
Rutherford and Royds chose to publish their work in this way.  [1]

[Diagram: thin cylinder A inside the centre of larger cylinder B]
The experiment lasted for 6 days. The decay constant of radium-226 is $1.4\times10^{-11}\ \mathrm{s^{-1}}$.
(i) Deduce that the activity of the radium-226 is almost constant during the experiment. [2]
(ii) Show that about $3\times10^{15}$ alpha particles are emitted by the radium-226 in 6 days. [3]
